full_name: Steven Epstein | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Social Sciences Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow Northwestern University
bio: Steven Epstein is a professor of sociology and the John C. Shaffer Professor in the Humanities at Northwestern University. Epstein studies the politics of knowledge—more specifically, the contested production of expert and especially biomedical knowledge, with an emphasis on the interplay of experts, health institutions, and social movements and with a focus on the politics of gender, race, and sexuality.
